requirements.title: Design and Development
requirements.description: Collaborate with product managers and other developers to analyze user needs and design, build, and deploy new software programs and features.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has demonstrated experience in designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence applications using React and Python/Flask, which aligns with the requirement to collaborate and design software solutions.

requirements.title: Coding
requirements.description: Write clean, scalable, and efficient code using established development practices and conventions.
requirements.explanation: The candidate mentions using modern development frameworks and a commitment to high-quality, maintainable code, indicating proficiency in writing efficient and scalable code.

requirements.title: Testing and Debugging
requirements.description: Conduct unit and integration testing and perform debugging to ensure strong functionality, optimal performance, and security.
requirements.explanation: The candidate has a proven track record of troubleshooting complex issues and implementing testing and debugging, as evidenced by their work on RBAC systems and data visualization issues.

requirements.title: Maintenance and Improvement
requirements.description: Maintain and improve the performance of existing software.
requirements.explanation: The candidate explicitly mentions maintaining business intelligence applications and optimizing SQL queries, which directly relates to maintaining and improving software performance.

wishes.title: Collaboration Skills

wishes.explanation: The candidate describes effective collaboration with cross-functional teams in their current role, though more specific examples of team dynamics or collaborative projects could strengthen this match.
